sloka: तवा ऽनुयाने काकुत्स्थ मत्ता नर्दन्तु कुञ्जरा: ।अन्त:पुरगता नार्यो नन्दन्तु सुसमाहिता: ॥ २.१०५.१२॥
transliteration: tavā 'nuyāne kākutstha mattā nardantu kuñjarā: ।anta:puragatā nāryo nandantu susamāhitā: ॥ 2.105.12॥

translations.english: O Rama, let the elephants following you, intoxicated with ichor, be heard trumpeting. Let the women of the inner apartment rejoice with composed minds (when they hear of your return).
